pokedexEntries.rb: Under a full moon, this POKéMON likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.

pokedexEntries.ye: A GENGAR is close by if you feel a sudden chill. It may be trying to lay a curse on you.

pokedexEntries.go: It steals heat from its surroundings. If you feel a sudden chill, it is certain that a GENGAR appeared.

pokedexEntries.si: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey’s shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

pokedexEntries.cr: Hiding in people’s shadows at night, it absorbs their heat. The chill it causes makes the victims shake.

pokedexEntries.rs: Sometimes, on a dark night, your shadow thrown by a streetlight will suddenly and startlingly overtake you. It is actually a GENGAR running past you, pretending to be your shadow.

pokedexEntries.fr: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.

pokedexEntries.lg: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be GENGAR’s doing.

pokedexEntries.em: Deep in the night, your shadow cast by a streetlight may suddenly overtake you. It is actually a GENGAR running past you, pretending to be your shadow.

pokedexEntries.di: It hides in shadows. It is said that if GENGAR is hiding, it cools the area by nearly 10 degrees F.

pokedexEntries.prl: Lurking in the shadowy corners of rooms, it awaits chances to steal its prey’s life force.

pokedexEntries.pt: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a GENGAR delighting in casting curses on people.

pokedexEntries.hg: It steals heat from its surroundings. If you feel a sudden chill, it is certain that a GENGAR appeared.

pokedexEntries.ss: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey’s shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

pokedexEntries.bw: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a Gengar delighting in casting curses on people.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a Gengar delighting in casting curses on people.

pokedexEntries.x: It hides in shadows. It is said that if Gengar is hiding, it cools the area by nearly 10 degrees Fahrenheit.

pokedexEntries.y: Hiding in people’s shadows at night, it absorbs their heat. The chill it causes makes the victims shake.

pokedexEntries.oras: Sometimes, on a dark night, your shadow thrown by a streetlight will suddenly and startlingly overtake you. It is actually a Gengar running past you, pretending to be your shadow.

pokedexEntries.su: Should you feel yourself attacked by a sudden chill, it is evidence of an approaching Gengar. There is no escaping it. Give up.

pokedexEntries.mo: It apparently wishes for a traveling companion. Since it was once human itself, it tries to create one by taking the lives of other humans.

pokedexEntries.us: You can hear tales told all over the world about how Gengar will pay a visit to children who are naughty.

pokedexEntries.um: Even your home isn’t safe. Gengar will lurk in whatever dark corner of a room it can find and wait for its chance to catch its prey.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: A Gengar is close by if you feel a sudden chill. It may be trying to lay a curse on you.

pokedexEntries.sw: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar’s doing.

pokedexEntries.sh: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.

pokedexEntries.bd: It hides in shadows. It is said that in rooms where Gengar is hiding, the temperature drops by nearly 10 degrees Fahrenheit.

pokedexEntries.shp: Lurking in the shadowy corners of rooms, it awaits chances to steal its prey’s life-force.

pokedexEntries.la: Possesses potential victims’ shadows in an effort to steal away the victims’ lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!

pokedexEntries.sc: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey’s shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

pokedexEntries.vi: Hiding in people's shadows at night, it absorbs their heat. The chill it causes makes the victims shake.
